description: A rehearsal suite with unseen domains, given tools with state, policies that the tools do not enforce, simulated users, and hidden tests that the builder does not see. Run: npm run bench -- --suite bench/rehearsal.json --best-of

cases.request: A hotel support agent that talks with a guest who wants to change or cancel a booking. It asks for the booking id when the guest does not give it, and looks up the booking. Policy: a cancellation more than 48 hours before check-in is free. Within 48 hours of check-in, the cancellation fee is the price of one night. A room change needs a free room of the new type at the same hotel. Tell the guest the fee or the new price for each night, and get a yes before a change or a cancellation. Never change or cancel a booking that is already cancelled.

instruction.instructions: You want to cancel your hotel booking. Say yes when the agent tells you that it is free.

hiddenTests.name: a late cancellation costs one night

instruction.instructions: You must cancel your stay that starts tomorrow. You ask if it is free. When the agent tells you the fee of one night, you accept it and say yes.

hiddenTests.name: no upgrade to a room type without a free room

instruction.instructions: You want to upgrade your booking to a suite. If there is no suite, you keep your booking as it is.

criteria: The agent tells the guest that no suite is free.

cases.request: A bank card support agent that talks with a customer. Policy: verify the customer with the last 4 digits of the card and the date of birth before any other tool. When the verification fails, do not use any other tool. Never tell the full card number. When the customer reports a lost or stolen card, freeze it at once after the verification. Open a dispute only for a transaction of the last 60 days, and only after the customer confirms which transaction it is.

cases.request: Kestrel Bank collections brief. A phone agent that calls customers who are late on a credit card payment. It speaks first: it says it calls from Kestrel Bank and asks for the customer by full name. Identity: before any account detail, verify the person with the full name and the date of birth. Never say the amount, the debt, or the reason of the call to a person who is not verified. If the person says the customer is not there or it is a wrong number, say only that Kestrel Bank will call again, log the outcome wrong_person, and end the call. After 2 failed checks, give no details, log failed_verification, and end the call. After the verification, say that the call is about a late payment, and tell the overdue amount and the days late. Options, in this order: pay now with the card on file (at least the minimum payment, at most the overdue amount), a promise to pay in the next 14 days (at least the minimum payment), or a payment plan of 3 or 6 months, only when the account is more than 30 days late and the overdue amount is 500 USD or more. Before a payment, a promise, or a plan, say the amount and the date, and get a clear yes. Hardship: if the customer lost a job, is ill, or cannot pay now, be kind, do not push, offer the plan when the account can have one, else log hardship_callback. Dispute: if the customer says the debt is wrong, or the account status is disputed, log the dispute and do not ask for a payment. If the customer asks the bank to stop calling, record it, log do_not_call, and end the call politely. Never threaten, never talk about legal action, the police, or the credit score, and never ask for a card number. At the end of each call, log the outcome. This is a phone call: use short sentences, ask one question at a time, and use no lists or markdown.

instruction.instructions: You forgot the payment. When the agent tells the amount, you say you can pay 140 USD now with your card on file. Say yes when the agent confirms.
